speaker: Doctor
text: I need to ask a few questions to narrow this down. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you had any recent infections or travel? Also, have you noticed any changes in your skin or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significant weight loss and night sweats, have you noticed any specific changes in your stool consistency or color, and do you have any known history of liver disease or recent travel? REQUEST TEST: Liver function tests, Complete blood count (CBC), and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver function tests: NORMAL READINGS, Complete blood count (CBC): WBC: Elevated, Hemoglobin: Slightly Decreased, Platelets: Normal, Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR): NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis (likely involving the liver or peritoneum given the abdominal pain).

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal CT scan.
REQUEST TEST: Acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear and culture of gastric lavage or stool, and T-SPOT.TB test.
